simple.meaning: מִשְׁבֵּר (mishbêr) is a Hebrew word meaning “the orifice of the womb (from which the fœtus breaks forth).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מִשְׁבֵּר (H4866) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 2 Kings 19:3, with occurrences in 2 Kings, Isaiah, Hosea.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִשְׁבֵּר (H4866) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מִשְׁבֵּר (H4866) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מִשְׁבֵּר (mishbêr) / H4866 is traced through 2 Kings 19:3, Isaiah 37:3, Hosea 13:13 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
